name: barbell power jerk
description: An explosive overhead lift where you dip, drive and catch the bar with locked arms in a quarter squat.
instructions: Rack the bar on your front shoulders with elbows slightly forward.
Dip a short way with your torso upright.
Drive up explosively and punch the bar overhead.
Dip under slightly and catch it with locked arms.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to your shoulders with control.
